## Adjust sales for final year  


$$
SIportion_{y} = (1 - AltFuel_{y}) \times \frac{ \left(  \frac{SISales_{y}}{SISales_{y} + CISales_{y}} \times \frac{SISales_{y}}{TotalSales_{y}}\right)}{{\frac{SISales_{y = 2050}}{TotalSales_{y=2050}} }}
$$
where 

$y$ is the given year.
